title: Proteomic atlas of carotid plaques with a machine-learning prognostic protein signature
summary: Proteomics of 219 carotid endarterectomy samples from 120 patients defined inflammation and calcification signatures, and multiobjective evolutionary feature selection feeding an SVM found a four-protein signature (CNN1, PROC, SERPH1, CSPG2/versican) predicting cardiovascular mortality, AUC 75.0% in discovery and 67.5% in 200 Athero-Express patients. Targeted proteomics validated the signatures. Validation AUC is modest, the data are observational, and machine learning is one part of the atlas.
ai_technology: Multiobjective evolutionary feature selection with a support vector machine

evidence.tested: Independent Athero-Express cohort (200 patients) and targeted proteomics (PRM) of signatures.
evidence.ai_role: Feature selection and SVM defined the minimal prognostic signature.

source_review.scope: Abstract and Europe PMC full-text Methods/Results excerpts read for this DOI. Author affiliations from OpenAlex metadata.
